# Codebase & SEO Audit: `dev-canvas`

## 1. What kind of site/app is this?

**Type:** Personal portfolio / lead-generation site for a freelance/senior developer, with a multi-step project inquiry flow.

**Stack:**
| Layer | Technology |
|-------|------------|
| Build | [Vite 5](c:\Users\NAZEEM\Documents\Projects\KN\dev-canvas\vite.config.ts) + [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](c:\Users\NAZEEM\Documents\Projects\KN\dev-canvas\package.json) |
| UI | React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui (Radix) |
| Routing | [react-router-dom v6](c:\Users\NAZEEM\Documents\Projects\KN\dev-canvas\src\App.tsx) (`BrowserRouter`) |
| Animation / 3D | GSAP, Three.js (@react-three/fiber, drei) |
| Data | TanStack React Query (minimal use) |
| Tests | Vitest |

**Not Next.js** — there is no `next.config`, no App Router, no SSR/SSG. This is a **client-side SPA** with a single static `index.html` shell.

**Routing** (`c:\Users\NAZEEM\Documents\Projects\KN\dev-canvas\src\App.tsx`):

| Route | Page component | Purpose |
|-------|----------------|---------|
| `/` | `src/pages/Index.tsx` | Single-page portfolio (hero, about, brands, skills, projects, experience, contact) |
| `/start-project` | `src/pages/StartProject.tsx` | 4-step onboarding form (project type → business info → scope → contact) |
| `*` | `src/pages/NotFound.tsx` | 404 |

**Entry point:** `src/main.tsx` → mounts `App` into `#root`. No shared layout component — each page composes its own UI.

**Deployment:**
- **GitHub Pages:** `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` runs `npm run build` on push to `main`
- **Docker/nginx:** `Dockerfile` + `nginx.conf` (SPA fallback via `try_files … /index.html`)
- **Optional gh-pages script:** `npm run build:gh-pages` sets `base: "/dev-canvas/"` and copies `index.html` → `404.html`

---

## 2. Current SEO setup

### Primary head source: `index.html`

All meta/head content is in one file — **no React head library, no per-route updates**.

```1:32:c:\Users\NAZEEM\Documents\Projects\KN\dev-canvas\index.html

    ...
    <title>KN20</title>
    <meta name="description" content="Full Stack Developer with 10+ years of experience. Specializing in Vue, Angular, Node.js, and modern web technologies." />
    <meta name="author" content="KN20" />

    <meta property="og:title" content="KN20" />
    <meta property="og:description" content="Dev Project" />

</html>
```

### `robots.txt`

**File:** `c:\Users\NAZEEM\Documents\Projects\KN\dev-canvas\public\robots.txt`

- Allows Googlebot, Bingbot, Twitterbot, facebookexternalhit, and `*`
- **No `Sitemap:` directive**
- **No `Disallow` rules**

### Sitemap

**None found.** No `sitemap.xml`, `sitemap-index.xml`, or sitemap generator in the repo.

### Favicon / PWA

- **No favicon** (`favicon.ico`, `.svg`, etc.) in `public/` or `index.html`
- **No `manifest.json`**
- **No `theme-color` meta**

### Analytics

- **Google Analytics 4** via gtag.js, measurement ID `G-L4671XD0BC` in `index.html`
- **No SPA route-change tracking** — navigations to `/start-project` won't fire virtual pageviews unless added in React
- No GTM container

### Per-route / dynamic SEO

Searched `src/` for `document.title`, `Helmet`, `useHead`, dynamic meta — **zero matches**. All routes share the same static `<head>` from `index.html`.

### Semantic HTML (on-page SEO)

**Strengths:**
- Homepage has one `<h1>` in Hero: "NAZEEM KHODABUX" (`src/components/Hero.tsx`)
- `<main>` wrapper on Index page
- Section IDs for anchor nav (`#skills`, `#projects`, `#work`, `#contact`)
- Brand logos have `alt={brand.name}` in `BrandMarquee.tsx`

**Weaknesses:**
- `/start-project` and success state each render their own `<h1>` while document title stays `KN20`
- 404 page has `<h1>404</h1>` but same global title
- Heavy JS/animations (Three.js, GSAP loading screen) — crawlers get content only after JS executes

### `vite.config.ts` SEO-relevant notes

- `base: "/"` for normal builds; `base: "/dev-canvas/"` only for `gh-pages` mode
- GitHub Actions workflow uses `npm run build` (base `/`), not `build:gh-pages` — worth aligning if deployed under a subpath

### `nginx.conf`

SPA routing only — no SEO headers (no `X-Robots-Tag`, no security headers that affect SEO).

## 3. Schema markup (JSON-LD)

**None.** No `application/ld+json` scripts anywhere in the codebase. No Person, ProfilePage, WebSite, or LocalBusiness schema.

Good candidates given site content:
- `Person` (name, jobTitle, url, sameAs for LinkedIn/GitHub)
- `WebSite` with `potentialAction` (contact)
- `ProfessionalService` or `ProfilePage`

## 4. Site content / purpose — who is this for?

**Person:** **Nazeem Khodabux** — Senior Full-Stack Developer, Curepipe, Mauritius, 10+ years experience.

**Purpose:** Portfolio to showcase work and convert visitors into project leads via `/start-project`.

**Key content sources:**

| File | Content |
|------|---------|
| `src/components/Hero.tsx` | Name, tagline (e-commerce, ERP, legacy rescues, LLM integrations), CTAs |
| `src/components/AboutSection.tsx` | Bio, stats (10+ years, 30+ projects, etc.) |
| `src/components/ExperienceSection.tsx` | Work history: Dragon Electronics, Uniconsults/SICORAX, Impetus Digital, Pam Golding, ARM Mauritius |
| `src/components/ProjectsSection.tsx` | Case studies with live URLs (dragonelectronics.mu, pamgolding.mu, pateloptics.mu, impetusdigital.io) |
| `src/components/BrandMarquee.tsx` | Client logos |
| `src/components/ContactSection.tsx` | Social links: GitHub, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp |
| `src/components/Footer.tsx` | © Nazeem Khodabux |
| `public/cv.pdf` | Downloadable CV |
| `sources/KhodabuxNazeem-FullStackDeveloper-CV2026.pdf` | Source CV (not in public by default path) |

**Branding mismatch:** README and `index.html` use **"KN20"** as project/brand name; all visible copy uses **Nazeem Khodabux**.

**Business model:** Freelance/consulting developer targeting legacy modernization, headless commerce, ERP, and AI/LLM integrations — not a product SaaS or company site.

## 5. `package.json`, layout files, head components

### `package.json`

**Path:** `c:\Users\NAZEEM\Documents\Projects\KN\dev-canvas\package.json`

- **name:** `vite_react_shadcn_ts` (Lovable/shadcn template default)
- **Scripts:** `dev`, `build`, `build:gh-pages`, `deploy`, `preview`, `test`
- **No SEO packages:** no `react-helmet-async`, `vite-plugin-sitemap`, `@unhead/react`, etc.

### Layout files

**None.** No `layout.tsx`, `_app.tsx`, or shared `Layout` component. Structure is:

```
index.html (static <head>)
  └── main.tsx
        └── App.tsx (router + global providers)
              └── pages/* (page-level composition)
```

### Head components

**None dedicated.** Head is only managed in `index.html`. Global UI wrappers in `App.tsx`:
- Toaster, Sonner, TooltipProvider, QueryClientProvider, CustomCursor

### Page architecture (`Index.tsx`)

Single scroll page with sections: LoadingScreen → Navbar → Hero → About → BrandMarquee → Skills → Projects → Experience → Contact → Footer → BackToTop.

## Highest-impact gaps (for future SEO work)

1. **Align branding** — title, author, OG tags should say "Nazeem Khodabux | Senior Full-Stack Developer" (or similar), not "KN20" / "Dev Project".
2. **Add `og:image`** — social shares currently have no preview image.
3. **Add JSON-LD `Person`** with `sameAs` links already in `ContactSection.tsx`.
4. **Add `sitemap.xml`** for `/` and `/start-project` (and submit in Search Console).
5. **Per-route titles** — e.g. react-helmet-async or a small `usePageMeta` hook for `/start-project` and 404.
6. **Favicon + apple-touch-icon** in `public/` and linked from `index.html`.
7. **SPA analytics** — fire `gtag('config', …, { page_path })` on route changes.
8. **Consider prerendering** (vite-plugin-ssr, prerender-spa-plugin, or hosting with SSR) so crawlers/social bots get full HTML without waiting on JS.

If you want this implemented, switch to Agent mode and we can prioritize the quick wins (title, OG, favicon, JSON-LD) first.
